full_judgment: 2. Title Suit No.367 of 2001was filed by the Opposite Party Nos.1 and 2 for setting aside the 'sole' decree obtained in Title Suit No.278 of 2000 on 5.8.2001. The petitioners as defendants contested the suit by filing written statement. While the suit was posted for pre-emptory hearing on the prayer of the plaintiffs an Advocate commissioner was appointed by the Court for taking down the deposition of Akram Ali, (P.W. 1) whose deposition was taken on 15.2.2002 and also he was cross-examined but after obtaining certified Copy, of the same, the petitioners found that some vital points as quoted in the petition were not noted. Thereafter, the petitioners filed application and ultimately it came to this Court in Civil Revision No.2586 of 2002. Thereafter on the prayer of the plaintiff, on 21.5.2002, learned Joint District Judge, Dhaka issued writ to examine Nuruzzaman as plaintiff witness through an Advocate Commissioner. It has alleged in the petition that Advocate Commissioner did not issue any notice and further alleged in the petition that Advocate Commissioner without issuing notice to the defendant petitioner, examined P.W.2. Shirin Akter and P.W.3 Nuruzzarnan and submitted report on 27.05,2002. In the meantime Civil Revision No.2586 of 2002 was disposed of with the observations that:
